svg.title: SpacetimeDB event-driven architecture
svg.desc: Event-driven architecture diagram for SpacetimeDB: WebSocket clients and Scheduler produce reducer-call and timer events; HostController dispatches to WASM/V8 module; committed transactions produce ModuleEvents broadcast via BroadcastQueue to SubscriptionManager consumers which push row deltas to connected clients.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do WebSocket clients call reducers in SpacetimeDB?')
g.text: Call reducer by name over WebSocket — reducer-call event

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does the SpacetimeDB Scheduler fire time-based events?')
sendPrompt('What does HostController do in SpacetimeDB?')
g.text: Dispatches reducer call to module instance
module_host_actor.rs — executes reducer, commits DB transaction

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What is a ModuleEvent and what does DatabaseUpdate contain?')
g.text: Contains DatabaseUpdate — full table row deltas from committed txn

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does BroadcastQueue work in module_subscription_manager.rs?')
g.text: module_subscription_manager.rs — async fan-out, no direct coupling

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does SubscriptionManager evaluate SQL queries against row deltas?')
sendPrompt('How does each SubscriptionManager filter relevant row changes?')
sendPrompt('Can there be many subscription managers in SpacetimeDB?')
sendPrompt('What does ClientConnectionSender do in SpacetimeDB?')
g.text: Push state-change events over WebSocket — no direct producer–consumer coupling
